short_description_zh: 明代苏州文人、画家、书法家、诗人。屡试不第，后以岁贡生授翰林院待诏。沈周弟子，与唐寅、祝允明、徐祯卿合称“吴中四才子”，在后世美术史中与沈周、唐寅、仇英并列“明四家”。
short_description_en: Ming dynasty Suzhou literatus, painter, calligrapher, and poet. Repeatedly failed the metropolitan examination; later appointed Hanlin Academy Drafter by suigong. Student of Shen Zhou; grouped among the 'Four Talents of Wu' and, in later art history, the 'Four Masters of the Ming'.
